issue.title: Let the child keep drawing while an AI picture is minimized on RN web
issue.body:
## What

On RN web, "Keep drawing while you wait" minimizes the AI card to its polaroid. The child then cannot draw: a `[data-testid="rsd-paper-corner"]` element covers the whole paper, with `pointer-events: auto`. On a 390x844 phone it measures 390x769 at y 75, exactly the paper's box. Strokes on the paper leave no ink and add no Undo step.

Shipping web, same steps, accepts strokes while the picture is being made: ink appears and Undo depth rises from 1 to 2.

## Why

Keeping the child drawing while the picture is made is the point of the minimized state: B0267, E0329, L0168 and the AI-1 acceptance row T1-12. Today the paper looks drawable but silently ignores every touch until the picture is opened again.

## Where

The polaroid's paper-slot overlay: `experiments/native-architecture/src/rsdDrawing/RsdPaperSlot.tsx` and the `rsd-paper-corner` host, plus `ai/AiWaitingPolaroid.tsx`. The layer that hosts the polaroid should pass touches through everywhere except the polaroid itself.

## Repro (rn-web, Chromium, iPhone-sized touch profile)

1. At 00fcc5c78d1031873db1a214301c008daa4bd080, run `npm run native:web:build`. Serve the export statically, and answer `/api/*` from a fixture: the generate-image reply is held, so the run stays in progress.
2. Settings › AI Art › Create AI Images on, then close Settings and draw one stroke.
3. Expand the drawer, tap Create AI image, then pick Sticker.
4. Tap "Keep drawing while you wait".
5. Draw a stroke across the middle of the paper.
6. Expected: ink, and Undo depth 2. Actual: no ink, Undo depth 1. `document.elementFromPoint` at the paper's centre returns the `rsd-paper-corner` div.

Evidence: AI-1 record, cells `ai-minimize-and-ready` and `ai-timeout` (`docs/scratchpad/2026-10-18-device-parity/results/ai-1-web-2026-10-19.md` on branch `claude/rn-web-parity-cloud`). Observed at 00fcc5c78; not re-run after #3006.

## Done when

- While an AI picture is minimized, strokes anywhere on the paper outside the polaroid ink and add Undo steps, as on shipping.
- Tapping the polaroid still reopens the card.
- AI-1 cell `ai-minimize-and-ready` shows the stroke drawn while minimized in both arms.

Refs #2978
issue.display_title: Let the child keep drawing while an AI picture is minimized on RN web

comments.body: Fixed by https://github.com/KyleMit/Splotch/pull/3049, merged into codex/native-migration as cbd94d9fd64c865b280e6d3cd98003e23fa02f71. The layer that pins the minimized AI polaroid over the paper now uses the pointerEvents prop rather than a style that react-native-web drops. On the RN web export in Chromium, the layer's own computed pointer-events is none, and a stroke under it adds ink while the picture is being made.
